title: Ambient cohomology and finite rank of an ordered Tate tower
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and the strict varying-coefficient tower category and its exact finite evaluations [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Let $X$ be a separated finite-type scheme over the algebraic closure of a finite field of characteristic different from $\ell$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. In any of the specified ordinary system coordinates [def-sp-tower-gamma-data], let $w$ be the given Tate-line presentation and let $r\geq0$. The ordered line $L_r=A_{\bullet,X}(r)[2r]$ has zero ambient ordinary-tower cohomology in all degrees $i\ne-2r$. For every positive coefficient level, the evaluation of $H^{-2r}(L_r)$ is locally free of rank one. At $r=0$ this is the coefficient unit; for empty $X$ the local rank assertion is vacuous. No input normalization is assumed.

source.place: (1), tower paragraph; step 6, cohomology of the coefficient-line source alone

proof.text: By [lem-pur-twist-sheaf-locally-free] the first integral Tate line and all of its finite uniformizer reductions are locally free of rank one. Write ell as a unit times pi^a and use the coefficient quotient at a(n+1), obtaining the ell^(n+1) quotient without an unramifiedness restriction. Its positive tensor powers and its zeroth power, the unit, have local rank one by [def-coefficient-twists-detailed].

On trivializing covers, tensor with each line is the identity and hence exact. Kernel and cokernel calculations for towers are levelwise by [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Therefore the ordinary tensor of the unshifted line towers computes the derived tensor. Induct on the orderedLine recursion: its zero case is a sheaf in degree zero, and each shifted degree-one factor changes the sole cohomology degree by -2. All off-degree cohomology systems have zero evaluations, hence are zero systems.

Exact evaluation commutes with the surviving homology and identifies it with the r-th finite Tate power. Step 1 gives the required local rank one. The coefficient unit gives r=0, and the same local statement is vacuous on the empty scheme.

lean.statement:
theorem ordered_tate_tower_cohomology (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (w : SpChartAdmissibility.Twists l E X) (r : ℕ) :
    (∀ i : ℤ, i ≠ -2 * (r : ℤ) →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SpTowerShriek.S l E X) i).obj
        (SpTowerGamma.orderedLine l E b X w r))) ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, ((SpTowerShriek.ev l E X n).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SpTowerShriek.S l E X) (-2 * (r : ℤ))).obj
        (SpTowerGamma.orderedLine l E b X w r))).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank 1
